legend: Bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of blasts (<<39422>>). Bone marrow differential reveals 91% blasts (<<39423>>). FISH analysis shows 99% of cells positive for BCR::ABL1 rearrangement (<<39424>>). Chromosomal banding for this case showed a karyotype of 46,XX,del(5)(q13q35),der(9)inv(9)(p12q13)t(9;22)(q34;q11.2),der(22)t(9;22)[9]/46,idem,add(15)(q26.1)[11] (data not shown).
